# Context Handoff

> Free, open-source Chrome/Edge/Brave extension (Manifest V3) that exports a long claude.ai conversation as a compact handoff, either an XML resume prompt or a Markdown file, so work can continue in a fresh chat or another AI assistant. All processing is local: no network requests, no analytics, and no access to cookies or credentials. MIT licensed.

Key facts:
- Compact mode keeps the first user message (task goal), the latest version of each named file from the middle of the chat, the last N messages (default 6), and a next-step field.
- Full transcript mode exports every message verbatim.
- Markdown conversion keeps code blocks with language tags, tables, lists, blockquotes and KaTeX math ($...$, $$...$$).
- Permissions: https://claude.ai/* (read the open chat), storage, alarms, notifications.
- It does not manage accounts and is not a tool for getting around usage limits.
- Install: clone the repo, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked.
